# PLAYCHIVE: complete catalog

> Every catalog record on https://playchive.ir with license, controls and rights status. Generated from data/games.json.

## Playable in the browser

### Blasphemer

A complete free dark-fantasy shooter running through Chocolate Heretic in its own WebAssembly module. It bundles the Blasphemer IWAD, starts with no player upload or external game download, keeps configuration and saves in the browser, and provides fullscreen plus PSP-style touch controls.

- Genre: Fantasy shooter
- Developer: Blasphemer project / Chocolate Heretic
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later engine and game data · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/blasphemer.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### C-Dogs SDL

A top-down retro action game running in its own C-Dogs SDL WebAssembly module. It includes the libre upstream campaign and dogfight data, has PSP-style mobile controls and never shares Doom’s WAD loader or game loop.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: C-Dogs SDL project
- License: GPL-2.0 engine · free upstream game data · attribution retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/cdogs.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### GNU FreeDink

A complete libre 2D action-adventure running in its own GNU FreeDink WebAssembly module. It includes official FreeDink game data, keeps saves inside the browser and has PSP-style touch controls without sharing Doom’s WAD loader or game loop.

- Genre: Exploration
- Developer: GNU FreeDink project
- License: GPLv3-or-later engine · official redistributable game data · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/freedink.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### OpenTyrian2000

An arcade vertical shooter running in its own OpenTyrian2000 WebAssembly module. It bundles the project-documented freeware Tyrian 2000 data, persists saves inside the browser and provides PSP-style touch controls without sharing Doom’s WAD loader or game loop.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: OpenTyrian2000 project
- License: GPLv2-or-later engine · project-documented freeware data · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime

- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### LibreQuake

A first-person action campaign using the classic Quake engine in its own Qwasm WebAssembly module. It bundles independent LibreQuake Lite data, keeps saves in the browser and has PSP-style touch controls without using original Quake assets or sharing Doom’s WAD loader and game loop.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: LibreQuake project / Qwasm
- License: GPL engine lineage · LibreQuake free game data · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/librequake.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### OpenTTD

A complete transport-strategy game in its own OpenTTD WebAssembly runtime. It bundles the free OpenGFX graphics, OpenSFX effects and OpenMSX music sets, keeps saves in the browser, includes PSP-style touch controls and never asks the player to upload Transport Tycoon Deluxe files.

- Genre: Strategy
- Developer: OpenTTD project / OpenGFX / OpenSFX / OpenMSX
- License: GPL-2.0 engine + OpenGFX/OpenMSX · OpenSFX attribution notice retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/openttd.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### FreeRCT

A complete clean-room theme-park strategy game in its own FreeRCT WebAssembly runtime. It bundles its own libre graphics, rides, scenery and scenarios, keeps saves in the browser and offers PSP-style touch controls without asking players to upload RollerCoaster Tycoon or OpenRCT2 files.

- Genre: Strategy
- Developer: FreeRCT project
- License: GPL-2.0-only engine and clean-room game data · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/freerct.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### Neverball

A complete 3D physics-puzzle game in its own Neverball WebAssembly runtime. It bundles the libre base game and Easy level set, keeps saves in the browser, includes PSP-style touch controls and never asks the player to upload data or download a campaign.

### Armawebtron

A complete existing open-source 3D lightcycle arena game, bundled from the GPL Armawebtron browser project. It launches immediately into the official Classic local preset with three AI rivals, ten rounds, neon trails, browser-local configuration, PSP touch controls, gamepad support and fullscreen—no account, upload or network server required.

- Genre: Arcade
- Developer: Glen Harpring / Armawebtron contributors
- License: GPL-2.0-or-later code and retained upstream source / assets
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/armawebtron.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### TuxRacer.js

A complete existing open-source 3D downhill racer, bundled from the TuxRacer.js project with its penguin, snow courses, music and sound. Race for the finish, collect herring and switch among twenty local courses with keyboard, the game’s touch joystick, PLAYCHIVE PSP controls, gamepad support and fullscreen—no upload, account or external game data required.

- Genre: Racing
- Developer: Jan Ebbe / Extreme Tux Racer & Tux Racer contributors
- License: GPL-2.0-only code and retained upstream credits / source
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/tuxracer.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### Starter Kit Racing

A complete existing Three.js driving game from mrdoob’s Starter Kit Racing. Accelerate a physical truck around a fully local track with real glTF road, forest, tent and vehicle meshes, lighting, smoke trails and lap timing—fully local with keyboard, PSP touch controls, gamepad support and fullscreen, without an account, upload, server or remote playable content.

- Genre: 3D Racing
- Developer: mrdoob / Kenney
- License: MIT upstream source · Kenney CC0 glTF models · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/starter-kit-racing.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### Astray

A complete existing WebGL physics-maze game, bundled from the Astray project. Roll a steel ball through dark three-dimensional brick labyrinths, build momentum around corners and reach an exit that generates the next, larger maze—fully local with keyboard, PSP touch controls, gamepad support and fullscreen, without an account, upload, server or external game data.

- Genre: Physics Maze
- Developer: wwwtyro / Astray contributors
- License: Unlicense / public-domain upstream source · notices retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled independent runtime
- Play: https://playchive.ir/astray.html
- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### Neon Rift

An original low-poly 3D night racer built for PLAYCHIVE. Thread three escalating rifts, collect signal cores, protect your boost and clear the route with keyboard, PSP-style touch controls, gamepad support and fullscreen—no upload, account or external game data required.

- Genre: Racing
- Developer: PLAYCHIVE

### Obsidian Relay

An original 3D survival-exploration game built through PLAYCHIVE’s OpenResident WebGL2/WebAssembly renderer path. Recover two signal cells, restore a stranded deep-sea relay and reach the emergency bulkhead while hostile echoes pursue you—fully bundled with keyboard, PSP-style touch controls, gamepad support and fullscreen.

- Genre: Survival
- Developer: PLAYCHIVE

- Controls: keyboard, touch, gamepad, fullscreen

### HexGL

### Hextris

## Doom-engine campaigns and local import

### Freedoom: Phase 1

A complete, libre Doom-compatible campaign designed as an independent base game. Four episodes make it the natural starting point for classic mapsets.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: Freedoom project
- License: BSD-style free content · attribution retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled IWAD

### Freedoom: Phase 2

A single 32-level campaign built for the Doom II ruleset, including the expanded monster roster and super shotgun used by many community mapsets.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: Freedoom project
- License: BSD-style free content · attribution retained
- Status: Free / bundled
- Runtime: Bundled IWAD

### FreeDM: Arena Archive

A libre 32-map deathmatch archive. PLAYCHIVE can launch the levels for local exploration, but it does not add bots, online play or matchmaking.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: Freedoom project
- License: BSD-style free content · attribution retained
- Status: Free / bundled · solo exploration
- Runtime: Bundled IWAD

### Hacx: Twitch ’n Kill

A cyberpunk 21-level Doom-engine campaign. This runtime layers the bundled Hacx archive over its bundled Doom II-compatible base, under Hacx’s royalty-free, non-commercial distribution terms.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: Banjo Software / Hacx project
- License: Custom royalty-free license · no commercial use · credit retained
- Status: Royalty-free / non-commercial bundle
- Runtime: Bundled IWAD + PWAD

### The Plutonia Experiment

A demanding Final Doom campaign known for compressed combat spaces and high-pressure encounters. PLAYCHIVE can launch a lawfully owned copy selected from your device, but does not distribute this IWAD.

- Genre: Horror
- Developer: Casali brothers / Final Doom
- License: Not bundled or hosted by PLAYCHIVE
- Status: Requires your legal IWAD
- Runtime: Commercial IWAD

### TNT: Evilution

A Final Doom campaign with industrial spaces, larger progression routes and authored set pieces. Attach a legally acquired TNT IWAD from your device to play it here.

- Genre: Exploration
- Developer: TeamTNT / Final Doom
- License: Not bundled or hosted by PLAYCHIVE
- Status: Requires your legal IWAD
- Runtime: Commercial IWAD

### Community WAD shelf

A local route for compatible mapsets and experiments. Attach one base IWAD and up to three PWADs; files stay in this browser session and are never uploaded by PLAYCHIVE.

- Genre: Experimental
- Developer: License-reviewed import
- License: Only archives you have the right to use
- Status: Attach a compatible WAD
- Runtime: IWAD + PWAD

## External browser projects (link only, not hosted by PLAYCHIVE)

### Ancient Aliens

A colorful 32-map synthwave megawad with custom music and a Boom-compatible ruleset. Use a compatible source port such as Woof! or DSDA-Doom; its files are not bundled here.

- Genre: Action
- Developer: skillsaw & collaborators
- License: Project download only · not bundled by PLAYCHIVE
- Status: External engine required
- Runtime: Doom II PWAD · Boom
- External link (not hosted by PLAYCHIVE): https://www.moddb.com/games/doom-ii/addons/ancient-aliens

### Eviternity

A six-chapter Doom II megawad built around distinct visual worlds and Boom features. Open its release with a Boom-capable port; the current browser runtime does not claim that compatibility.

- Genre: Exploration
- Developer: Dragonfly & team
- License: Project download only · not bundled by PLAYCHIVE
- Status: External engine required
- Runtime: Doom II PWAD · Boom
- External link (not hosted by PLAYCHIVE): https://www.moddb.com/mods/eviternity

### Back to Saturn X: E1

A polished two-WAD science-fiction episode with custom art and music. The project release supplies both PWAD files; add them locally to a compatible Doom II base archive.

- Genre: Exploration
- Developer: BTSX team
- License: Project download only · not bundled by PLAYCHIVE
- Status: Download project WADs locally

- Genre: Experimental

### OpenResident

An open C engine studied for a future browser port. The upstream source has no Resident Evil game data and currently targets X11/GLX or Win32/WGL, so PLAYCHIVE does not package, emulate or launch it as a game.

- Genre: Horror
- Developer: XProger
- License: BSD 2-Clause engine code · no game data bundled
- Status: WebAssembly study · not playable
- Runtime: Resident Evil engine
- External link (not hosted by PLAYCHIVE): https://github.com/XProger/OpenResident

- Genre: Racing
- Developer: SuperTuxKart team

## Rights and external entries

PLAYCHIVE distinguishes bundled libre/open-source content from local-file imports and external projects. Each catalog entry keeps upstream attribution and license information. Commercial copyrighted game data is not presented as bundled free content.

Entries marked `EXTERNAL LINK` are link-only references: PLAYCHIVE does not mirror their code, WASM, game archives, maps, assets, trademarks or multiplayer services, and they are excluded from the Offline Pack. Agents must not describe them as local PLAYCHIVE runtimes or PLAYCHIVE-owned downloads.
